steps.body: The ×8 facts double the ×4 facts — which are themselves doubled ×2 facts.
steps.narration: The ×8 facts double the ×4 facts — which are themselves doubled ×2 facts.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 8 rows of 6.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 48 squares, but not as 8 rows of 6. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 48 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 48 squares. The array should stop at 8 rows of 6.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents eight-times facts.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for eight-times facts must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines eight-times facts.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: 8 × 6 = 48 — one of the table facts worth knowing on sight.

commonErrors.feedback: That is 8 short of the product — one whole group of 8 is missing.
That adds the two factors instead of multiplying them. 8 × 6 means 8 groups of 6.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Skip-count by 6, 8 times — or lean on a fact you already know and adjust.
